examples.title: A tidy base
examples.text: The site stays fast and up to date, one article goes live, and website enquiries now land in your CRM instead of an inbox.

examples.title: More leads, less admin
examples.text: A new landing page, a CRO test on your contact form, and leads automatically qualified and assigned to the right person.

examples.title: Connected systems
examples.text: A B2B price list in the shop, conversion tests on the key pages, and a dashboard that shows sales, leads and open orders in one place.

terms.title: Discovery first
terms.text: A free call to understand your site, processes and goals. You get a fixed monthly price before anything starts.

terms.title: Priced by result, not hours
terms.text: Each month we agree priorities with you. No timesheets, no surprise invoices.

terms.title: Minimum 3 months, then monthly
terms.text: After the first three months you can cancel any time, effective at the end of the month.

terms.title: Save on annual billing
terms.text: Pay for 12 months upfront and save {discount}% on any plan.

terms.title: Licences and accounts stay yours
terms.text: You pay software vendors directly, from your own accounts.

terms.title: Prices excl. VAT
terms.text: Prices are shown in US dollars and exclude any applicable VAT or sales tax. Clients in the EU and UK can be invoiced in euros. [Confirm VAT handling with your accountant.]

faq.a: Because no two businesses have the same site and processes. The plan sets the scope; the discovery call sets the exact monthly price, which then stays fixed.

faq.q: Why are prices in dollars on the English site?
faq.a: Because the English site is mainly for clients in the US. Clients in the EU and UK can be invoiced in euros — the euro prices are on the German version of this page.

faq.q: Which plan should we start with?
faq.a: If you mainly need a reliable website and a first process in order, start with Essentials. If you want more leads and less admin, Growth is the usual starting point. The free audit ends with a recommendation.

faq.q: Do you bill by the hour?
faq.a: No. You pay a monthly price for an agreed scope. We plan priorities with you every month and report on results, not timesheets.

faq.q: What if we need more in one month?
faq.a: Larger pieces of work — a new site, a CRM rollout, an internal app — run as a fixed-price project next to your plan. If it keeps happening, moving up a plan is usually the better deal.
After the minimum three months, the plan ends at the end of the month you cancel. You keep everything: code, content, tools, accounts and documentation.

faq.q: Do you sign an NDA and a data processing agreement?
faq.a: Yes. We sign your NDA on request, and a data processing agreement (DPA) is part of every plan.

founding.title: 25% off for our first five clients
founding.text: We're a new team with senior people and few public case studies yet. Our first five clients get 25% off any monthly plan for the first six months — in return for permission to publish the results as a case study and a short testimonial.
founding.note: Limited to five clients. Applies to monthly plans, not to fixed-price projects.
